purpose: Create a pre-order preview and margin what-if queue from M111 account-scaled paper tickets, then optionally request IBKR broker-side what-if margin preview with whatIf=true and transmit=false.

ibkr_live_whatif_probe.interpretation: Farm status messages were non-blocking. Error 321 showed the API interface is currently in read-only mode, so broker-side what-if margin response was not returned.

interpretation.status: M112 local preview queue is ready. Broker-side IBKR what-if adapter is implemented but blocked by the current read-only IBKR API session.
interpretation.finding: All 25 account-sized paper tickets are previewable as stock what-if order drafts, but each still requires human review because fractional-share support must be confirmed; 10 also require short borrow/locate and short margin review.
interpretation.recommendation: Keep local preview queue as the pre-trade checklist. If broker-side what-if margin is required, enable an IBKR session mode that permits what-if order validation while keeping transmit=false, then re-run ibkr-order-whatif-preview.
